pages.page_lead: Photographs from a 1987 Oakland celebration honoring Ronald V. Dellums’s first twenty years in elected public service.
history_paragraphs: Ronald V. Dellums began his elected career on the Berkeley City Council in 1967 and entered the U.S. House of Representatives in January 1971. He became known for his opposition to the Vietnam War and military spending, his advocacy for civil rights, and his work against apartheid in South Africa. For additional context, see the U.S. House of Representatives’ historical biography.

On May 31, 1987, supporters and guests gathered at Oakland’s Hyatt Regency Hotel to celebrate twenty years since Dellums first took elected office. Photographs preserved with the celebration show speeches, musical performances, portraits of guests, and the presentation of a commemorative plaque.

pages.page_lead: Photographs of people gathered outdoors near a brick building, provisionally associated with political activity.
history_paragraphs: People converse, pose together, serve food, and sit in an outdoor audience. Several photographs show a brick-building backdrop; another depicts two people in conversation beside a building. Some participants appear to hold papers or wear buttons.

The collection steward considers these scenes likely to be associated with political activity. The particular occasion, participants, organizers, date, and location remain unknown; the original physical association of all the photographs has not been established.

pages.page_lead: Photographs of community ball games and young athletes in uniform.
pages.history_heading: At the ball field and on the bleachers
history_paragraphs: At an outdoor ball field, players take turns at bat while spectators gather near the fence. In other photographs, children wearing matching athletic jerseys sit on wooden bleachers, talking and posing together.
The scenes show participation in neighborhood sport, but the youth team's identity, its particular sport, and any relationship to the ball-field photographs have not been established.

pages.page_lead: Street processions, musical performances, and outdoor community gatherings.
history_paragraphs: Mounted riders wearing western attire proceed along a city street. Elsewhere, a singer performs beside an upright-bass player, while other photographs show people seated on grass, conversing and posing together outdoors.
These scenes may come from several different occasions. The festivals, procession dates, performers, organizers, and locations have not yet been established.

pages.page_lead: Close portraits centered on expression, gesture, and composition.
history_paragraphs: Portraiture brings attention to the person photographed. In these photographs, framing, expression, and gesture take precedence over the surrounding setting. The identities, dates, and locations of individual portraits remain under research.
